title: SyntaxMind at BLP-2025 Task 1: Leveraging Attention Fusion of CNN and GRU for Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of a deep learning model (BanglaBERT fused with CNN and Bi-GRU) on classifying Bangla text into hate speech categories, specifically evaluating its ability to detect 'Religious Hate'.
